Primary source: products/revenue/cells.json (p2-registry + p3-router on 10 chains, with code_bytes/deploy_tx per row). Secondary: products/revenue/FEE-RAISE-PLAN.md (g2a-OP 0x61AB1942…), products/revenue/OP-RAIL-PLAN.md (OP USDC + g2a-OP), products/g2b-escrow/MULTICHAIN-DEPLOY-EVIDENCE.md (g2a/g2b on opBNB/Gnosis/Scroll), products/*/KEY-RECORD*.md, and exec3/GATE6-MIGRATION-PLAN.md §1 (the v2 line). Every 40-hex value below was LIVE code-probed on its chain this run AND re-EIP-55'd via `cast to-check-sum-address` (2026-11-10). `native` is the zero sentinel. The rails interface (src/addressBook.ts) reads these live and checksums each on read.
$note_v2_base_only: The nested `v2` block is the next-generation line from exec3/GATE6-MIGRATION-PLAN.md §1 — BASE ONLY (chainId 8453). The other 9 chains stay on the v1 addrs at each chain's top level. A reader must NOT assume v2 is multi-chain. Every v2 addr was live code-probed 2026-11-10 (non-zero runtime, keccak below) and is EIP-55 valid.
$note_create_invariance: p2 Registry and p3 Router sit at CHAIN-INDEPENDENT addresses where the same deploy key hit the same nonce (CREATE = keccak(rlp(key,nonce))[12:]). p2 = 0xe9515881… on ALL 10 chains (4654 B each). p3 = 0xEB28D5cA… on BASE ONLY; the other 9 chains carry p3 at 0x9651cD59… (4270 B). ⚠ 0x9651cD59… is ALSO the Base f1a RequestRegistry (2772 B) — same bare string, different contract PER CHAIN (#95). Never key on a bare address without the chain.
